consensus_summary: Fans generally enjoyed the intimate setting of the Des Moines Civic Center and appreciated the energy of the performance. Highlights included strong jamming and notable renditions of several songs, particularly in the second set.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 23 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the performance and atmosphere, there were also criticisms regarding the sound quality and some song selections, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
